profile.name: Somya
profile.limitations: Forgets recent events. Needs one short instruction at a time. Can get anxious in crowds.
profile.remembers: Shrikar, old songs, family dinners, the neighborhood where they grew up.
profile.forgets: What day it is, where they left their things, faces they met today.
profile.easy: Walking short distances, washing their hands, sitting down at a table, drinking water.
profile.notes: Demo persona. Likes to be called Somya.

places.seat: Your seat, next to your bag
routeToBathroom: Stand up slowly. Step back a little.
Head to the gate, in the top right corner.
Go through the gate, then turn left.
The bathroom is the first door on your right.
routeBack: Turn around and head back to the gate.
Your seat is the one with your bag.
